svg.title: Base Case — $1,025,000 Gross Activity to $143,500 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-bridge; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case — $1,025,000 Gross Activity to $143,500 Owner Profit; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the canonical 14.0% gross-basis net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per year. First and final bars are absolute totals; four interior bars are signed deductions. Formula v2.0 fixes gross activity at $1,025,000, retained_share at 0.35, retained contribution at $358,750, and owner profit at $143,500. The three post-merchandise expense allocations are editorial reconciliation assumptions, not supplied engine line items. The scorecard's retained metric does not replace an ASC 606 principal-versus-agent assessment for reported revenue.; caption: $1,025,000 − $666,250 − $108,000 − $61,500 − $45,750 = $143,500. Owner profit is 14.0% of gross activity and 40.0% of $358,750 retained contribution.; stages: label: Gross scorecard activity; value: $1,025,000 annual gross-basis starting total; numeric value: 1025000.0; detail: Aggregate the canonical wholesale reimbursement, commercial reward, and treasury-yield activity basis. Exclude card credit limits, borrowed principal, supplier GMV outside this operation, and sweep transfers.; label: Landed merchandise deduction; value: −$666,250 leaves $358,750 retained contribution; numeric value: -666250.0; detail: Apply the canonical 65% blended merchandise-cost deduction. The remaining 35% is the supplied retained contribution metric, not an assertion that every buying-group order earns a 35% merchandise spread.; label: Pod and recurring operating cost; value: −$108,000 leaves $250,750 before variable deductions; numeric value: -108000.0; detail: Illustratively allocate $72,000 to contractor support and $36,000 to systems, bookkeeping, insurance, and recurring administration. Total recurring opex equals $9,000 monthly. Owner labor is compensated through the resulting owner-profit measure.; label: Payment and carrying cost; value: −$61,500 leaves $189,250 before fulfillment losses; numeric value: -61500.0; detail: Deduct illustrative transaction fees and actual financing or carrying charges. Do not count repayment of card principal as an expense or treat an unused credit line as earned income.; label: Incremental fulfillment losses; value: −$45,750 leaves $143,500 annual owner profit; numeric value: -45750.0; detail: Deduct incremental return freight, realized parcel losses, and settlement shortfalls after recoveries. Exclude amounts already included in landed merchandise cost and avoid adding a second expense for the same loss.; label: Owner profit total; value: $143,500 — 14.0% gross and 40.0% retained margin; numeric value: 143500.0; detail: Render this endpoint as a total anchored at zero, not as another positive increment. Preserve the canonical owner-profit definition without inserting additional personal-tax or owner-draw assumptions.

text.title: Base Case — $1,025,000 Gross Activity to $143,500 Owner Profit
text.tspan: Base Case — $1,025,000 Gross Activity to $143,500 Owner

circle.title: label: Gross scorecard activity; value: $1,025,000 annual gross-basis starting total; numeric value: 1025000.0; detail: Aggregate the canonical wholesale reimbursement, commercial reward, and treasury-yield activity basis. Exclude card credit limits, borrowed principal, supplier GMV outside this operation, and sweep transfers.

label: Landed merchandise deduction; value: −$666,250 leaves $358,750 retained contribution; numeric value: -666250.0; detail: Apply the canonical 65% blended merchandise-cost deduction. The remaining 35% is the supplied retained contribution metric, not an assertion that every buying-group order earns a 35% merchandise spread.

label: Pod and recurring operating cost; value: −$108,000 leaves $250,750 before variable deductions; numeric value: -108000.0; detail: Illustratively allocate $72,000 to contractor support and $36,000 to systems, bookkeeping, insurance, and recurring administration. Total recurring opex equals $9,000 monthly. Owner labor is compensated through the resulting owner-profit measure.

label: Payment and carrying cost; value: −$61,500 leaves $189,250 before fulfillment losses; numeric value: -61500.0; detail: Deduct illustrative transaction fees and actual financing or carrying charges. Do not count repayment of card principal as an expense or treat an unused credit line as earned income.

label: Incremental fulfillment losses; value: −$45,750 leaves $143,500 annual owner profit; numeric value: -45750.0; detail: Deduct incremental return freight, realized parcel losses, and settlement shortfalls after recoveries. Exclude amounts already included in landed merchandise cost and avoid adding a second expense for the same loss.

label: Owner profit total; value: $143,500 — 14.0% gross and 40.0% retained margin; numeric value: 143500.0; detail: Render this endpoint as a total anchored at zero, not as another positive increment. Preserve the canonical owner-profit definition without inserting additional personal-tax or owner-draw assumptions.

text.title: Assumptions: USD per year. First and final bars are absolute totals; four interior bars are signed deductions. Formula v2.0 fixes gross activity at $1,025,000, retained_share at 0.35, retained contribution at $358,750, and owner profit at $143,500. The three post-merchandise expense allocations are editorial reconciliation assumptions, not supplied engine line items. The scorecard's retained metric does not replace an ASC 606 principal-versus-agent assessment for reported revenue.
